name: Haard Parikh
bio: Mechanical engineer who'd rather build startups than machines. Always pitching something, always traveling somewhere, running on coffee and bad sleep. Future founder, current chaos agent.

name: Deepak Umaraiya
bio: Founder and builder passionate about technology, AI, and entrepreneurship. I enjoy turning real-world problems into scalable products and businesses.

name: Abhijit Das
bio: AI/ML enthusiast, analytical thinker, and strategic design-minded problem solver. I work at the intersection of technology, data, and visual communication to turn complex ideas into clear, outcome-driven solutions.

name: Pari Panwar
bio: B.Des student. I ideate, build, and refuse to let a good idea sit unused. Dancer at heart, entrepreneur in ambition. Half creative brain, half business brain, running on caffeine and too many open tabs.

name: Gagan Tak
bio: Leading SInC's mission to turn campus ideas into real ventures.

name: Amrutanshu Dash
bio: Music, sports, and a dangerous amount of vibecoding. I build things at odd hours, record music at odder ones, and run events at SInC in between. Easy to find, easier to talk to.

name: Tejasva Sharma
bio: I'm usually either watching anime, playing games, or figuring out where to go next. I like meeting new people, exploring random places, and trying things I haven't done before.

name: Lakshya Kumar
bio: Love fitness and content creation — weightlifting and chess (complete opposite polarity). I love financial markets but they don't love me. Also a part-time startup enthusiast, sometimes CP too.

name: Om Anand Jha
bio: Designer by the day, engineer by night. I'm an amateur, clumsy know-it-all, figuring out where I fit in. I believe in building real products, and hope to do something in the manufacturing sector.

name: Vanshika Dhandhi
bio: I enjoy exploring new ideas and figuring out how they can actually work in the real world. Especially interested in startups, building products, and solving everyday problems through practical solutions.

name: Aditya Kumar
bio: I play all sports and love to talk to strangers. My favourite hobby is watching movies.

name: Kajal Panwar
bio: I love listening to music, roaming around campus, and writing unnecessarily BIG prompts to AI until it finally understands what I mean.

name: Shreya Munot
bio: Curious by nature and driven by the excitement of turning ideas into action. A B.Tech in Design student at IIT Delhi, I enjoy exploring the intersection of creativity, entrepreneurship, and technology.
